    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    var regex = /^[A-Za-z\s]+$/;

    if (!regex.test(newValue)) {
        alert('Drop Location must contain only alphabets. Numbers and special characters are not allowed.');
        g_form.clearValue('drop_location');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('drop_location', 'Only alphabets allowed.', 'error');
    } else {
        g_form.hideFieldMsg('drop_location', true);
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-15 04:47:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>10c02096839bcb50edccc430ceaad39b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Drop location</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Car Rental Request Automation">1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_10c02096839bcb50edccc430ceaad39b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-15 05:22:41</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Car Rental Request Automation">1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a0a38474460000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_10c02096839bcb50edccc430ceaad39b</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>1.0.0</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Car Rental Request Automation</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-15 05:22:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>3839641a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad323</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-15 05:22:41</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Car Rental Request">7857e7298317c750edccc430ceaad398</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:142827a98317c750edccc430ceaad374</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Future Requested dates</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading, isTemplate) {
    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    var selectedDate = new Date(newValue);
    var today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    selectedDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    if (selectedDate <= today) {
        alert('Requested Date must be a future date. Today or past dates are not allowed.');
        g_form.clearValue('requested_date');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('requested_date', 'Please select a future date.', 'error');
    } else {
        g_form.hideFieldMsg('requested_date', true);
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-15 04:31:41</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>6ddc5c5e835bcb50edccc430ceaad3ad</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Future Requested dates</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Car Rental Request Automation">1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_6ddc5c5e835bcb50edccc430ceaad3ad</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-15 05:22:42</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Car Rental Request Automation">1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a0a38476420000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_6ddc5c5e835bcb50edccc430ceaad3ad</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>1.0.0</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Car Rental Request Automation</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-15 05:22:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>8139641a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad34c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-15 05:22:42</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    var regex = /^[A-Za-z\s]+$/;

    if (!regex.test(newValue)) {
        alert('Pickup Location must contain only alphabets. Numbers and special characters are not allowed.');
        g_form.clearValue('pickup_location');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('pickup_location', 'Only alphabets allowed (e.g., Vijayawada).', 'error');
    } else {
        g_form.hideFieldMsg('pickup_location', true);
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-15 04:40:35</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ba2f9892839bcb50edccc430ceaad389</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate pickup location</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Car Rental Request Automation">1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_ba2f9892839bcb50edccc430ceaad389</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-15 05:22:42</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Car Rental Request Automation">1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a0a38476ea0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_ba2f9892839bcb50edccc430ceaad389</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>1.0.0</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Car Rental Request Automation</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>1839241a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad381</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-15 05:22:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>c139641a83dbcb50edccc430ceaad367</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-15 05:22:42</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>
